Weekly signup growth for 2025: return the week start (date_trunc week, cast to a date), the number of signups that week, and the week-over-week percentage change in signups rounded to 1 decimal place (NULL for the first week).

Virtual try-on to purchase funnel: among users who have used virtual try-on (only try-ons linked to a non-null user id), how many are there, how many went on to place an order (any status) at or after the time of their first try-on, and what is that conversion percentage rounded to 1 decimal place? Return the three numbers.

Does audience size correlate with contribution? Split all non-deleted users into two segments by follower count, labeled exactly '100+' (at least 100 followers) and '<100' (fewer). Return the segment label, the number of users in it, and the average number of wardrobe products added per user rounded to 1 decimal place (users with no products count as 0).
